queries: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count * 1.0) FROM per_account) AS ratio FROM per_account ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average number of transactions per account is the mean of per-account transaction counts over accounts present in trans (equivalently total rows / distinct accounts).
Any type other than 'PRIJEM' (including VYDAJ, VYBER, and any NULL-free other value) is treated as negative, as the request states.

assumptions.assumption: Every type other than 'PRIJEM' (including VYDAJ, VYBER, and any other value) is treated as negative, as the request states.
The average number of transactions per account is total rows in trans divided by the number of distinct account_ids in trans, computed in floating point, with no rounding.

responses.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count * 1.0) FROM per_account) AS ratio FROM per_account ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average number of transactions per account is computed over accounts present in trans (total rows divided by distinct accounts), using floating-point division so nothing is truncated.
Every type other than 'PRIJEM' (including 'VYDAJ', 'VYBER', and any other value) is treated as negative, as the request states; no type is NULL-excluded.
